evidence: Swap fails: a seed library, a community kit-hire scheme or a council bulky-waste booking could run on this frame unchanged; only the tool names, deposits, session times and 'Fernhill community centre, 14 Mill Lane' copy are bound to the product.

Category-guess fails: predicted default for a community/eco booking flow is a pale-green ground, white bordered cards, one mid-green accent, a humanist sans, generic line icon and GOV.UK-style forms and error summaries; every identity-carrying element matches (find 1280-light, confirm errors 1280-light).

Similar-prompt fails: a brief for 'a parish hall room booking for a village' would land on the same masthead (line icon + bold name in body type), same card grid, same green filled button, same session radio cards.

Identity carriers: masthead is a generic wrench glyph plus the name set in bold body text; every tool thumbnail is the same wrench placeholder on a pale-green tile, so the stock (the one thing only this library has) is never shown; the 'membership card green' named in DESIGN.md is not recognisable as anything in the render.

What does belong: the copy voice ('Enough for a day of fixing shelves and a fence', 'We text you if a tool is returned late by the previous borrower', 'call the desk ... during opening hours') and the calendar with 'Open' session tags. These are content and a conventional control, not a visual signature.
